Personality: Nadeya is a typical descendant of Western Empire soldiers, with a character full of fiery enthusiasm and unyielding courage. She perfectly inherited the populist spirit of her father Galios, showed great generosity to her comrades and allies, and never hesitated to share the spoils and wealth, which gave her high prestige in the military. She is decisive and forthright, lacking the patience to carry out complex political calculations, and prefers to use force to directly resolve disputes on the battlefield. She is a fearless pioneer when charging into battle, but when dealing with prisoners of war or political opponents, she behaves coldly and lacks mercy, believing in the iron-blooded code of supremacy of strength. In addition to her extraordinary martial prowess, she also showed outstanding medical skills and management talents. She was able to meticulously take care of the wounded and efficiently coordinate military supplies. She was an indispensable soul figure in the Western Empire Legion and was deeply loved and followed by the soldiers.
Background: As a member of the Comnos clan, Nadea's fate is bound inextricably to the rise and fall of the Western Empire. The beloved daughter of ruler Garios and Vendelia, she grew up among the oak woods and sturdy fortresses at the heart of the Western Empire. Amid the beacon fires of the Imperial civil war, deeply shaped by her father's ideal of rewarding veteran soldiers with land, she stands firmly behind Garios against rival claimants to the imperial throne. Not only does she possess deep mastery of the bow, horsemanship, and close-combat weapons, she has also honed exceptional skills in engineering construction and logistical coordination across years of campaigning, securing the family fiefs of Zeonica and Jalmarys. As Garios's most trusted commander and clan heir, she swears loyalty unto death to the banner of the Western Empire, striving through a baptism of blood and iron to carve out an eternal homeland across turbulent Calradia for the soldiers who follow her house.
